versions.changelog: rc.3: scan the last 14 days, confirm one route, then work it through offer, test, acquisition, delivery, cashflow review, and rerank

Initial release of offer-engine skill.

- Converts approved opportunity evidence into a single, narrowly-defined, sellable offer.
- Separates known facts, evidence, assumptions, and open questions; cites material evidence.
- Defines strict workflow and output requirements, including Offer Brief headings and economic sensitivity analysis.
- Implements untrusted input safeguards and rules for handling evidence, authority, and regulated work.
- Requires explicit human approval before any external action; prohibits unauthorized execution or hidden outcomes.
